alternativeExplanations.title: Power rule trap
steps: Trying the power rule on $x^{-1}$ gives $\frac{x^0}{0}$ — division by zero. The power rule fails exactly at $n = -1$.
That gap is filled by the logarithm: $\frac{d}{dx} \ln x = \frac{1}{x}$.
